launcher.notes: KINETRIX 2.10.0 — LINUX SUPPORT. The launcher now runs on Windows AND Linux: a portable AppImage (no install, no root) plus a native .deb for Debian/Ubuntu/Mint. Nothing was cut — Microsoft sign-in, offline accounts, Quick Play, the cosmetics locker with the 3D preview, auto-update, the crash doctor and the full FPS stack all work the same. The Linux build installs the real Linux native libraries (LWJGL/OpenAL), auto-installs Temurin JRE 8 for Linux (or finds your distro JVM), and self-updates in place. Windows behavior is untouched.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.11.0 - Main Menu exact-reference pass: your sunset backdrop is now the real menu background (self-verifying POT ladder - no more black backdrop on gl4es devices), translucent reference-measured glass panels, blur owned by the existing Menu Blur setting only, true text scaling on every device, cleaner buttons, all actions preserved.
